_: Climb content pack 'Zip line' (owner 2026-10-06 night: Climb content ships as data under game/data/climb/, one pack per run; the owner session wires the loader, CI never edits climb.gd). Units are the tower's px like climb.gd (36 px = 1 m, +y up, x 0..960). scripts/games/climb_zip.gd reads this file: plan(n, plats, taken) works only on the `themes` floors minus the vent floors (the `only` rules), looks at every pair of consecutive still hops in the climbing order (the piece's `on` kinds — hop i−1 is the lower hop a, hop i the upper hop b) that leave a sideways gap of min_gap..max_gap px with the upper hop min_dy..max_dy higher, whose cable box (from the lower hop's top up to the upper post's cap, between the two posts plus a body's width) no other platform cuts — a moving hop with its whole sweep — and no `taken` piece of another pack (the hammock net, the rope bridge, the ghost slab, the mushroom — the loader passes their plans) meets; one zip line per floor over the widest such gap: a post `inset` px inside the upper hop's gap edge rising post_h px over its top, a post inset px inside the lower hop's gap edge rising low_h px, a cable between their caps, a trolley (two wheels, a hanger, a bar DROP = 8 px under the cable) parked at the top, a rubber bumper `stop` px before the lower post, and a haul line from the trolley to a winch on the upper post. Airborne with Up, hands (feet + hang) within reach_x/reach_y of the parked bar catch it (zing); the trolley rolls down the cable from rest at G × sin(slope) × roll px/s², at most max_v, the cable sagging `sag` px under the body at the middle; over the last `brake` px before the bumper the speed eases to v_end; at the bumper (clunk) the body is set down over land_s to the lower hop's top and let go (done — that tick's y is the hop's top so the loader's own landing takes over). Down or SPACE lets go with the trolley's velocity split along the slope (vx = dir × v × cos, vy = −v × sin). The first pack that goes down on purpose: a fast way back to a hop you missed, or off a hop the plain jump from which goes nowhere. A freed trolley is hauled back up its line over return_s (the winch clicks every click_s) and cannot be caught until it is parked. build(root, planned) draws it; grab(x, y, z) is the Up test; ride(riding, dt, fig) every hanging tick returns the body's x/y, done/lost and the velocity; let_go(riding) returns the velocity. `pose` is the Stick3D pose_request while hanging (stick3d_zip.gd). tools/probe_zip.gd checks the plan and its refusals, the geometry, the reach, the roll, the brake, the set-down, the let-go, the return, the visuals, the sounds and the pose.
name: Zip line

zip._: min_gap/max_gap: the sideways gap between the two hops (px). min_dy/max_dy: how much higher the upper hop is (px; consecutive hops are 92..138 apart). inset: px each post stands inside its hop's gap edge. post_h: the upper post's cap over its hop's top (px) — the cable's top end; the parked bar hangs DROP (8) under it, so a hanging body's feet are post_h − 8 − hang = lift px over the upper hop. low_h: the lower post's cap over its hop's top (px). hang: hands over feet (px, like the holds). reach_x/reach_y: how far the hands may be from the parked bar to catch it (px). roll: the share of G × sin(slope) the trolley rolls with (the rest is the bearings). max_v: the fastest the trolley rolls (px/s). stop: px before the lower post where the bumper sits. brake: px before the bumper over which the speed eases to v_end (px/s). sag: px the cable gives under a body at the middle of the run. land_s: seconds the set-down at the bumper takes. return_s: seconds the winch takes to haul a freed trolley back to the top (eased); click_s: seconds between its clicks. zing_hz: the cable singing when the bar is caught or let go; clunk_hz: the trolley meeting the bumper; click_hz: the winch's ratchet.

pieces._: Hanging garden floors are 5..9, 40..44, 75..79 …; the vent/windmill floors ((n − 3) % 4 == 0: 7, 43, 79 …) stay without a zip line — the wheels own the gaps there. The hammock net (run 135) takes the widest free gap on the same floors and is passed as `taken`, so the zip line spans the widest gap the net does not sling under; the vine curtain hangs over a hop's middle, 42 px or more from its edges, so a post at inset 24 never stands in it. One zip line per floor, over the widest gap of 60..200 px between two consecutive still hops 60..150 px apart in height.
